handoff:
SAL0MANder asset scout task.

Role: Gemini text scout. Do not edit Unity gameplay. Do not generate or commit image files. Return JSON manifests/prompts only.

Goal: improve the SAL0MANder puzzle picture-content library with clean, reusable, kid-friendly prompts and rights notes.

Rules:
- prompts only; no final art files;
- no copyrighted characters, logos, real children, classroom PII, or photoreal school children;
- group by runtime pack/theme, not only by file type;
- follow the production mix: cute animals first, then fantasy/space, with crossover bonus unlocks;
- every asset needs Unity approval before import;
- if blocked for 10 minutes, record SCOUT_UNREACHABLE and move on.
